gold: IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis

selector.rationale: Neutrophilic dermatosis with ulceration and intracorneal neutrophils, along with painful subcutaneous nodules and moderate inflammation in the sigmoid colon, support Pyoderma gangrenosum as the most likely diagnosis

rejected.label: Inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: While the patient has diverticulosis and colonic polyps, the primary symptoms and biopsy results point towards a skin condition

rejected.label: Erythema nodosum
rejected.why: The presence of well-demarcated vegetative crusted plaques and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation are not typical of Erythema nodosum
